changelog:
Initial release of model-guard.

- Automatically monitors Anti-Gravity model quotas.
- Switches the default model to the one with the highest remaining quota.
- Falls back to the native gemini-flash model if all quotas are below 20%.
- Can be triggered manually or configured to run automatically (e.g., via cron).
- Threshold and fallback model settings are configurable in guard.js.
summary: Monitors Anti-Gravity model quotas and automatically switches to the model with highest quota or falls back to gemini-flash if all are below 20%.
